name: com.wagenheimer.buildpipeline
description: Modular, multi-project build automation pipeline for Unity 6: one sidebar window for every setting, per-profile language lock, a Defines center (layered stack, package-declared define registry, find-usages in code, Free/Full code impact), multi-store profiles, language/variant batch builds, AppDeployHub vault signing, and 100% headless CLI with a JSON catalog for CI/AppDeployHub.
